mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_log WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND type = #{type} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_log (id, sku_id, order_no, type, quantity, biz_no, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{skuId}, #{orderNo}, #{type}, #{quantity}, #{bizNo}, #{remark}, NOW())
